description: Defines the CryptoFramer class and related interfaces for framing and parsing cryptographic handshake messages in QUIC protocol, including visitor interface and message construction methods.

classes.name: CryptoFramer
classes.description: Handles framing and parsing of crypto handshake messages in QUIC, manages state, and interacts with visitor interface.

classes.name: CryptoFramerVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when crypto framing events occur, such as errors or complete handshake messages.

methods.name: ParseMessage
methods.description: Parses exactly one crypto handshake message from input data.

methods.name: set_visitor
methods.description: Sets the visitor callback interface for framing events.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the last error code encountered.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data for framing, with optional encryption level parameter.

methods.name: InputBytesRemaining
methods.description: Returns number of unprocessed bytes remaining.

methods.name: HasTag
methods.description: Checks if a specific tag has been seen in the message.

methods.name: ForceHandshake
methods.description: Forces processing of handshake message even if incomplete.

methods.name: ConstructHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Creates a serialized QuicData object from a handshake message.

methods.name: set_process_truncated_messages
methods.description: Enables processing of truncated messages for debugging.
